login_sso_prod.title: RiskHub brings risks, controls, and approvals into one operating flow.
login_sso_prod.description: RiskHub helps teams manage risks, controls, approvals, and governance workflows in one place.
login_sso_prod.detail: Production access runs through your corporate Microsoft account and then maps permissions from your RiskHub role.
login_sso_prod.card_body: Secure single sign-on for internal RiskHub users in the production environment.
login_sso_prod.security_note: SSO for corporate accounts with role-based permission mapping.

native.invitation_only: Ask your administrator for an invitation to create an account.
native.recovery_help: Lost your authenticator and backup codes? Contact your administrator. Privileged accounts require the operator recovery process.
native.setup_help: Prepare an authenticator app, then request your setup key.
native.setup_manual: Add this key to your authenticator as a time-based account, then enter its current six-digit code. Keep the key private.
native.backup_help: Store these codes somewhere private. Each code works once. You cannot view them again after leaving this screen.
native.enrolled: Your account is ready. Sign in with your password and, if enabled, your authenticator.

errors.invalid: The details or code were not accepted. Check them and try again. If your link or challenge has expired, start again or request a new invitation.
errors.limited: Too many attempts. Wait before starting again.
errors.unavailable: Authentication is unavailable. Start again when the service is restored.
errors.uncertain: The response was lost and the action may have completed. Do not submit it again. Return to sign in; use password reset or contact your administrator if needed.
errors.forbidden: This action is not available for your account or deployment. Start again or contact your administrator.
errors.expired: This verification has expired. Start again to get a new challenge.

native.reset_sent: If this address is eligible, you will receive a password reset email.
native.reset_done: Your password is set. Return to sign in. Any existing MFA requirement still applies.
native.missing_link: Open a current invitation or recovery link from your email. If it has expired or been replaced, request a new one.
native.recover_help: Follow the recovery instructions approved by your administrator or operator. Changing your verified address requires both recovery messages.
native.recover_factor: Replace authenticator; I know my password
native.grant_help: Paste the complete link from the other recovery message. Keep both links private.
native.password_help: Use 15–128 characters. Choose a unique password or passphrase that is not commonly used.
native.changed: Your security change is complete and your previous sessions have ended. Sign in again.
native.password_unchanged: This is your current password. Nothing changed and your sessions remain active. Choose a different password to replace it.
native.email_sent: Check your new address for a verification link. Your current address remains active until you confirm the change.
native.mfa_enabled: Authenticator verification is enabled for your account.
native.mfa_disabled: Your account currently uses password-only sign-in.
native.security_action: What would you like to change?
native.email_confirm_help: Enter the new address that received this verification link.
native.recent_help: Verify your identity to approve this specific change.
native.language_error: The language could not be loaded. Try selecting it again.
native.notification_failed: Your change succeeded, but its security notification could not be sent. Contact your administrator.
